subject: Self-serve signup: lightning demo connect link & next steps
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@finhub.io>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for signing up — quick demo link and next steps

Hi Ben —

Thanks for signing up and kicking the tires with Redwood Inference. I’m Monica on the SDR team; wanted to send a quick, automated-but-personal invite to get you in front of one of our solution folks. If you already picked a slot inside the product, ignore this — otherwise use the link below to grab a 15–20 minute walkthrough that focuses on cost, latency, and deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private).

Pick a time: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/monica/15min?slot=lightning
(There are a handful of early-morning and late-afternoon slots if your team is distributed.)

What we typically cover in 15 minutes:
- A quick summary of your use case (you can paste notes in the booking form)
- Redwood runtime highlights that affect unit cost and latency
- Which deployment mode (hosted, dedicated, private) is a fit and next steps to trial

I attached a short 2-page Lightning Deck that hits the above. If you’d prefer I can loop in Diego (AE) for a slightly longer call with an architecture sketch — Diego is CC’d.

Thanks — hope one of the times works.

Best,
Monica Patel
SDR, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-lightning-deck.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Turner <ben.turner@finhub.io>

Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — quick demo link and next steps

Monica — thanks for the quick note. I tried the link but most of the available slots are during our East Coast crunch. Can you / Diego offer a few late-afternoon PT or early-evening ET options next week? Preferably Nov 6 or Nov 7 between 8pm–10pm ET.

A couple quick details on our side:
- Use case: embeddings + chat for internal analytics tool (low latency for short queries, cost is a big factor)
- Expected monthly tokens: ~15–25M initially

If easier, you can propose two times and I’ll confirm. Thanks!

—Ben
Ben Turner
Head of Data Platforms, FinHub Analytics
ben.turner@finhub.io | (617) 555-0123
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — quick demo link and next steps

Hi Ben — Diego here (AE). Appreciate the details — they help a lot. Monica, thanks for the deck. Ben, we can absolutely accommodate a later slot. I just proposed two short options below and attached a calendar invite stub for the first one:

Option A: Thu Nov 6 — 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET (30 min)
Option B: Fri Nov 7 — 8:30 PM ET / 5:30 PM PT (30 min)

I’m looping Marissa (solutions engineer) for the technical portion if you want to go deeper on KV-caching and batching strategies in the same session or follow-up. If you confirm Option A I’ll send a full calendar invite with dial-in and a short pre-read.

Quick note on fit: given your token estimate, we’ll show a couple levers — batching + prefix caching + a targeted quantization profile — that typically move unit cost and latency in measurable ways for analytics-style queries.

If neither works, paste two times that are convenient and I’ll match them.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0147
